resources.string: Context compression timed out. The original history was retained. Try again later.

The compression response has no complete terminal marker. No partial summary was used, and the original history was retained. Retry or check service protocol compatibility.
The compression model could not authenticate. The original history was retained. Check the provider settings.
The compression model is rate-limited. The original history was retained. Try again later.
The compression service is temporarily unavailable. The original history was retained. Try again later.
The connection was interrupted during compression. The original history was retained. Check the connection and try again.
The summary was still truncated, so the incomplete result was not used. The original history was retained.
The current history could not be fully processed within the compression budget. The original history was retained. Try a different compression model.
This session already has a compression task. Wait for it to finish.
Context compression did not finish or returned an invalid result. The original history was retained.
